title: 5 Question Words in Arabic
text:
5 Question Words in Arabic 👉 Swipe through the pictures, once a day this week.

ما — maa — what?
مَن — man — who?
أين — ayna — where?
كم — kam — how many?
متى — mataa — when?

title: 5 Lifesaver Phrases in Arabic
text:
5 Lifesaver Phrases in Arabic 👉 Swipe through the pictures, once a day this week.

ببطء، مِن فضلك — bi-buT', min faDlik — Slowly, please.
كيف أقول بالعربية؟ — kayfa aquulu … bil-'arabiyya? — How do I say … in Arabic?
أعد، مِن فضلك — a'id, min faDlik — Repeat, please.
ماذا يعني «فنجان»؟ — maadhaa ya'nii finjaan? — What does "finjaan" mean?
لا أفهم — laa afham — I don't understand.

▶️ Full lesson: Arabic Survival Phrases: Slower, Please, and Repeat

title: Days of the Week in Arabic
text:
Days of the Week in Arabic 👉 Swipe through the pictures, once a day this week.

الأحد — al-aHad — Sunday
الاثنين — al-ithnayn — Monday
الثلاثاء — ath-thulaathaa' — Tuesday
الأربعاء — al-arbi'aa' — Wednesday
الخميس — al-khamiis — Thursday
الجمعة، السبت — al-jumu'a, as-sabt — Friday, Saturday

title: 6 Colors in Arabic
text:
6 Colors in Arabic 👉 Swipe through the pictures, once a day this week.

أحمر — aHmar — red
أزرق — azraq — blue
أخضر — akhDar — green
أصفر — aSfar — yellow
برتقالي — burtuqaalii — orange (burtuqaal = an orange)
وردي — wardii — pink (ward = a rose)
